premises.text: Regular status reports contain valuable business information that is often inaccessible to the rest of the company
premises.evidence_span: these communications that are loaded with valuable business information are sent by email from one person to another, and the rest of the company can't access them

premises.text: Inaccessible status reports lead to less informed decisions and duplicated work
premises.evidence_span: As a result, decisions are less informed, work is duplicated, and ultimately, companies lose money because of this

premises.text: ThinkVue simplifies the process of creating and sharing status reports
premises.evidence_span: all we need to know is who you want status reports from, when you want them, and what information they should include

premises.text: ThinkVue allows users to manage recipient lists easily and follow projects
premises.evidence_span: each of these people can follow a project just as easily as they can follow someone on Twitter

premises.text: Status reports can be used to map relationships between people and projects within a company
premises.evidence_span: we're mapping the relationships between people and projects in a company

premises.text: ThinkVue provides access to information that is typically stuck in individual inboxes
premises.evidence_span: her company has that information, but she can't access it because it's stuck in someone else's inbox

premises.text: Understanding the entire puzzle of company operations is crucial for achieving shared goals
premises.evidence_span: The single most important driver to achieving a shared goal isn't good management. It's not team morale. It's not even your planning process.

premises.text: ThinkVue enhances the accessibility and consistency of status reports across an organization
premises.evidence_span: ThinkFuse provides this understanding by making status reports more accessible, by making them more consistent, and more powerful to align people and resources across an organization

value.text: Companies can make better-informed decisions and reduce duplicated work through accessible status reports
value.evidence_span: ThinkFuse provides this understanding by making status reports more accessible, by making them more consistent, and more powerful to align people and resources across an organization
